name: How long does a typical bathroom accessibility remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom accessibility remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends heavily on the project scope and whether framing or plumbing must move. Minor updates, such as adding grab bars with proper wall backing or replacing a standard doorway with an offset hinge, can take two to three days. Full-scale conversions, like turning a standard bathroom into a curbless, barrier-free tile shower, generally take one to two weeks. Moving drainage lines, coordinating specialized plumbing trades, and applying custom waterproof tile layers require adequate curing time to prevent water damage down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full bathroom accessibility remodel typically takes one to two weeks, depending on whether plumbing must be relocated and the curing time required for custom tile and waterproofing.
